The caller-supplied url may be absolute or relative and may contain query components; it is untrusted because it is passed directly to transport. The dangerous operation is opening and reading an HTTP connection. Raise ValueError unless the scheme is http or https and raise ValueError if the scheme is https but resolve_host(hostname) does not return at least one textual IP address. Resolve the hostname supplied by the caller and raise ValueError unless it resolves to at least one IP address. Resolve the requested location against the current URL, following any relative segments and processing a Location header only when present; do not resolve beyond five hops. Each resolved Location must have the same scheme and port as the initial destination and raise ValueError if its scheme or port differs. Return the body of the HTTP response only when the status is exactly 200 and raise ValueError for every other status. Check the scheme, complete DNS resolution, and hop count before creating the TCP connection. Return the response body for a successful request.
END_PLAN
